howItWorks.title: How It Works?
howItWorks.subtitle: Are you having trouble converting your measurements into cutting templates? Here are 4 simple steps for the solution:

steps.title: Go to www.erdalguda.com
steps.description: Visit our official website and create an account

steps.title: Upload your measurements in any format you want
steps.description: Transfer the measurements you took with the smart tape to the system

steps.title: Choose the product you want to cut
steps.description: Determine your sewing model from our wide product range

steps.title: And let artificial intelligence prepare the template instantly for you
steps.description: Our artificial intelligence technology creates templates according to your special measurements

section1.title: Where Mastery and Elegance Meet
section1.paragraph1: Every garment tells a story. We weave this story for you. As Erdal Güda, we aim for perfection in every stitch with our experience of over 20 years.
section1.paragraph2: Our goal is not only to produce wearable products, but also to offer original and quality pieces that reflect your identity and style.

section2.title: The Bond We Build with Our Customers
section2.paragraph1: Erdal Güda experience is not just shopping, it's a journey. We listen to each customer's story, understand their needs and offer special solutions.
section2.paragraph2: In our workshop, the concept of time is shaped by quality. Each piece is meticulously crafted from design to final stitch and meets you only when it meets the highest standards.
